items.requirement: The headline and supporting copy explain confidence in agent-written code without slowing the reader down.
The page uses a light background with no dark sections.
A Before section describes reading plans, questioning assumptions and giving the agent clearer decisions, visibly labeled prototype.
An After section emphasizes grouped local review, code-anchored questions, human accept/reject decisions and same-tab revisions.
Illustrations are SVG diagrams, not photographs or product screenshots.
The hero illustration plays automatically with no stage buttons, playback toggle, replay control or other visitor interaction.
items.source: Human follow-up: remove the three state buttons and Play motion / Replay

items.requirement: The hero's left station is labeled Your full diff and represents every change from the user's agent, not just one changeset.
items.source: Human copy follow-up: the whole diff on the left

items.requirement: The hero's right station is labeled Ship with confidence and represents confidence in reviewed code, not the location of the review decision.
items.source: Human copy follow-up: confidence in shipped code on the right

items.requirement: The middle retains YOUR FOCUS, Critical / Read closely, Important / Follow the change, and Tested / Check evidence.
items.source: Human copy follow-up: leave the middle unchanged

items.requirement: The middle review opens and closes briskly, while the right-hand verdict and return to the agent move more slowly. The sequence remains continuous and the return begins after the verdict.
items.source: Human timing follow-up: accelerate the middle, slow the right side and return

items.requirement: The hero's forward connections terminate at small ports on the agent, review and verdict platforms, without floating arrowheads or disconnected line fragments.
The hero uses one evenly dotted return connection below the platforms; the forward connections and sheet annotations are solid.
items.source: Human precision follow-up: inconsistent dotted lines

items.requirement: On desktop, the Critical, Important and Tested annotations connect directly to their corresponding sheet edges, without crossing other labels.
A real installation command and setup-guide link are visible.
Copy states that Syneva is local and uses the user's agent rather than running its own model.
